title: feat(console): the sidebar object entry offers Object settings, and the folded list menu leads with it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9GPJ8pmbK219Pay95x25Uno)_
Fixes #36487
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 系统管理员打开任一对象的列表页（自建应用和安装来的应用都算），点右上角「⋮」，第一项是新加的「对象设置」，点了打开 Studio 里这个对象（能看到字段）；左侧菜单对象项「…」里原来的「设计」改成「对象设置」，仪表盘、页面菜单项不再有「设计」。
- 属于「运行界面的设计模式」专题：给列表页一个进入对象设置的入口，替代页头将要去掉的「编辑应用」「在 Studio 中查看」两个按钮。
- 只有系统管理员会看到变化，普通成员不受影响；出错最坏是入口不出现或打开到 Studio 的数据页，可整体撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

1. **The list's ⋮ More leads with Object settings.** `ObjectViewMoreMenu` (`objectViewPageHeader.tsx`) takes the gated path from `ObjectViewPageBarActions` and draws `ObjectSettingsMenuItem` first, above the object's description, Import and the favorites entry, with a separator after it. It opens `appStudioObjectPath`: the object in Studio's Data surface, where its fields are. No separate Manage fields entry. The two existing entries are unchanged.
   - The narrow header's folded ⋯ (`objectViewHeaderChrome.tsx`) leads with the same entry (`object_view_object_settings`).
2. **Admins only, built and installed apps alike.** One gate for every menu that draws the entry: `useObjectSettingsGate(path)` is the app bar's `useStudioEntryGate` in either posture. A writable package (an app built here) gives `edit` and a read-only one (an installed app) gives `view`. A kernel package's app and a member get nothing. No new admin check.
3. **The sidebar ⋯ menu.** An `object` entry (and an `object:` favorite) offers **Object settings** where it offered Design, with the same destination as item 1. A `dashboard`, `page` or `report` entry, and such a favorite, offers no Studio entry. `sidebarItemDesignPath` / `favoriteDesignPath` keep their names (their caller `UnifiedSidebar.tsx` is outside this card's surface) and now answer for objects only. The sidebar entry now shows on read-only (installed) packages too, through the one shared gate (accepted in the claim amendment).
4. **Unsaved edits.** Every entry navigates through `confirmUnsavedLeave`, the existing seam (item 4, kept literal per the claim amendment).

`console.nav.design` is replaced by `console.nav.objectSettings` in all 11 locale packs (no existing key to reuse; the Chinese text is the card's own 对象设置). Changeset: `.changeset/36487-object-settings-entry.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/i18n`, patch).

### Read first

1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/SidebarItemMenu.tsx`: `useObjectSettingsGate` (the posture choice: read-only packages get the entry) and `sidebarItemDesignPath` (dashboard and page dropped).
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewPageHeader.tsx`: `ObjectViewPageBarActions` reads the route and the gate; `ObjectViewMoreMenu` draws the entry first.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewHeaderChrome.tsx`: the hook now reads the route and the gate itself.

### Two-minute check

As a workspace admin, open HotCRM's Accounts list and click ⋮ at the right end of the view bar. The first entry reads Object settings, and it opens `/studio/PACKAGE/data?surface=object:account`. As a member, the same ⋮ shows the description and Add to favorites only.

## Acceptance (card) against this PR

| Card line | Status |
|---|---|
| Built app list ⋮: first item Object settings, opens the object in Studio | Done, pinned (writable package) |
| HotCRM list ⋮: same | Done, pinned (read-only package) |
| Member: no Object settings in ⋮ | Done, pinned (member, admin without authoring, kernel app) |
| Sidebar object entry ⋯: Object settings, no Design, same destination | Done, pinned |
| Sidebar dashboard entry ⋯: no Design | Done, pinned (navigation entry and favorite) |
| Sorted, unsaved list, then Object settings: unsaved prompt | Dropped by the area as a false premise (claim amendment); the entry goes through the existing seam, pinned with a registered edit |
| Before/after screenshots | NOT MEASURED, reason below |

## Tests

Forced edits to existing tests (each because Design became Object settings, or because its rule changed):

- `SidebarItemMenu-12427.test.tsx`: labels; `sidebarItemDesignPath` now null for page, dashboard and report entries.
- `SidebarItemMenu.designAsksUnsaved-13231.test.tsx`: label only.
- `SidebarItemMenu.designFollowsPackagePosture-12615.test.tsx`: a read-only (installed) package's entry and favorite now list Object settings; a kernel favorite and a member get none (new cases).
- `SidebarItemMenu.designOpensStudio-12520.test.tsx`: dashboard and page entries and favorites now answer null.
- `UnifiedSidebar.favoritesMenu-12427.test.tsx`: labels, plus a dashboard favorite's menu offers no Studio entry.

New:

- `views/objectViewPageHeader.objectSettings-36487.test.tsx`: the list ⋮ shows Object settings first, above the description, for an admin on a writable package and on a read-only one. A member, an admin without authoring and a kernel app get none. With an unsaved edit registered, the click asks and Cancel stays; OK opens the object in Studio. A control case with nothing registered opens Studio without asking.
- `views/__tests__/objectViewHeaderChrome.objectSettings-36487.test.tsx`: the folded menu, same four questions.

<details><summary>Readings (head b3af5fd8)</summary>

- Lock depth before each locked run: depth 1, hold at 2, go.
- At caeacab0: touched suites, both new pins, the seven ObjectView header suites and all of `packages/i18n/`: 121 files, 2121 passed, 13 skipped; lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- b3af5fd8 changes one test file only (the folded-menu pin read the router address through a module variable, which `Lint UI` refused); both new pins re-run there: 2 files, 11 passed, VERDICT command-exit 0. `pnpm run lint` in `ui/packages/app-shell`: exit 0, 0 errors.
- Type check: `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell`, 69/69 tasks successful (`tsc --noEmit` and `tsconfig.test.json`).
- Ablation (list ⋮ item): `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` turned `{objectSettingsPath && (` into a constant-false guard (anchor 1 to 0, blob b3d6a422 to 3d8f5609); the new pin went 4 failed / 3 passed (the member, no-authoring and kernel cases stay green, as they should); restored, blob equal to HEAD b3d6a422, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Ablation (gate, earlier head 4958e709): `useObjectSettingsGate` mutated to the edit-only posture; 3 cases red; restored, blob equal to HEAD.
- ui gates: `check:i18n-keys`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:new-line-citations` all exit 0.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 41 commands): all 41 exit 0 on head b3af5fd8; `--ran` reconciliation: 41 derived, 41 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The sorted-unsaved-list line: the list's unsaved sort lives in the list draft store. That store never registers with the unsaved-edits seam and is built to survive in-app departures. One-off reading: after `patchListDraft(scope, sort desc)`, `confirmUnsavedLeave` asked 0 times and ran the departure once. The area kept item 4 literal and dropped that line (claim amendment).
- Phone: the phone's top-row ⋮ is built in `ObjectView.tsx`, outside this card; not offered there (noted by the area for a later card).
- `UnifiedSidebar.tsx` still says "Design" in a comment and passes `designPath`; outside this card's surface, left as is.
- Screenshots NOT MEASURED: no Console was booted in this container for this card. The dispatch allowed the lightest dogfood path only when the lock and a console fit in reasonable time, and every acceptance line above is pinned by a unit test instead.
